name: HVAC Ventilation Principles
summary:
HVAC Ventilation Principles is an immersive VR training application developed to help learners understand the fundamentals of ventilation systems in HVAC. Through interactive simulations, users explore airflow concepts, duct design, ventilation components, and system performance in a realistic, hands-on environment.
